The story relies on a very literal, understated, and realist style rather than figurative language. While there are a few common expressions and mild personifications—such as a sound going "through her teeth" (*Das Geräusch ging ihr durch die Zähne*), water "creeping" up her sleeve (*kroch es kalt bis zum Ellenbogen*), or the waves "smacking" (*schmatzen*)—these are standard, everyday descriptions in German rather than original, impactful metaphors or character-defining idioms. Furthermore, there are no literary, historical, or cultural allusions present in the text; the emotional weight is instead carried entirely by subtext, physical actions, and concrete details.
